title: Magenta craft as a trigger for the Axis

tellings.quote: just wonder was this part of what drove the decision to create what we now call the axis?

plain: Harald Malmgren, a former adviser to US presidents, talks about the "Magenta craft", an unexplained craft that the tellers link to Italy in the 1930s. He wonders aloud whether it helped push Italy and Germany into forming the Axis, the alliance they led in the Second World War. If so, it would mean a UFO helped shape the road to that war.
